reason: The plugin automates opening the system default browser after the DSH web server becomes ready, with optional delay and disable settings across Windows, macOS, and Linux.

summaries.zh: DSH Web 启动并监听成功后自动打开系统默认浏览器，也支持配置延迟或关闭自动打开。
summaries.en: Automatically opens the system default browser when the DSH Web server is ready, with options to add a delay or disable opening.

capabilities: Reads the web server port after startup
Opens the system default browser using platform-specific commands
Supports configurable automatic opening and delay
